composition.runtime_owner: existing RuntimeCoordinator remains the only Task and queue execution owner
composition.state_source: existing SQLiteStateStore and existing Discord pointer/delivery metadata
composition.progress: bounded latest task/event projection with durable delivery-key deduplication
composition.human_request: pending existing HumanRequest records are rendered to the bound channel/thread with request-id delivery deduplication
composition.approval: approval projection is available only through an explicitly injected Core-owned view boundary; the standard runner does not invent or consume approval authority

delivery.gateway_start: standard runner starts one read-only projection loop after on_ready
delivery.retry_boundary: a transient observation/send exception does not terminate the projection loop; the next bounded pass observes again
delivery.idempotency: existing Discord delivery metadata is the durable boundary

verification.credential_pattern_scan: no supplied Bot Token/application credential pattern found outside ignored environment files
verification.gateway_login: prior local smoke PASS for Gateway login, on_ready, and application-command synchronization
verification.ordinary_message_e2e: NOT_VERIFIED; an interactive Discord client was unavailable, and no historical-message backfill exists
verification.progress_live_delivery: NOT_VERIFIED against a real Discord channel
verification.human_request_live_delivery: NOT_VERIFIED against a real Discord channel
verification.approval_button_live_delivery: NOT_VERIFIED; standard runner has no explicit Core-owned approval view/submit callback

limitations: The runner must be online before a Human sends a new Discord message; this implementation does not infer live ingress from message history.
The outbound publisher is a projection only and does not claim Tasks, wake queues, retry work, approve, or integrate mutations.
No formal Gate is promoted by this local evidence.
